checks: Read full cash-ceiling section and surrounding pages11–14 in official archived hearing statement.

Distinguished formal suspicious-transaction reporting from identity checks, transaction recording and practical discovery. The lead cannot be proved solely by showing that GwG43reporting applies independently of value/payment method for obligated businesses.
reasoning: The sentence is conditional. A broad reading wrongly links absence of a cash ceiling or electronic record to absence of reporting duties. A narrower defensible reading concerns unregulated private transactions or the practical inability to identify suspicious cash flows. Surrounding discussion of information from private businesses and cash couriers does not decisively select the broad reading. It is not an unequivocal denial of every existing reporting duty.
recommended_next_step: Keep unresolved unless the exact scope can be established or an explicit description of a particular reporting regime is contradicted. Do not convert imprecise causal wording into a proved general legal assertion.
